Subject: Multi-region residency deep-dive (EU/US/APAC) — request to schedule

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks for the overview last week. Our security and infra teams want a technical deep-dive focused on EU/US/APAC data residency and the operational controls around migration and failover. High level asks:
- Walkthrough of region routing, data partitioning, and KV cache semantics across replicas
- Compliance evidence points (audit logs, KMS integration, retention controls)
- Canary / fallback behavior for cross-region outages

Target audience: our infra director + security lead + two engineers (3–5 people). We need the session to be technical and include a short Q&A.

Preferred week: Sep 13–17 (we're in CET). Would you have a 60–75 minute slot? I attached our preliminary compliance questions.

- Tue Sep 14: 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Sep 15: 11:00–12:30 or 16:00–17:30
- Thu Sep 16: 08:30–10:00 (APAC-friendly)

I've attached a suggested agenda (RDW-ACME-architectural-agenda.pdf) — covers routing policy, cache priming, prefix/KV behavior, replication failover lanes, and compliance checkpoints.

For the dry-run, I propose we include Vivek (runtime), Karthik (infra ops) and Marissa (solutions). Vivek: can you confirm availability Sep 13–16 for an internal run-through? Karthik: any preferences for breakout ownership (APAC/EU)?
